jobs.occupation: Full-Stack Software Developer (m/f/d): TETTRIX project (Fachinformatiker/in - Anwendungsentwicklung)
jobs.description: Full-Stack Software Developer (m/f/d): TETTRIX projectSenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Center (SDMC) at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as soon as possible:Full-Stack Software Developer (m/f/d): TETTRIX project(Full-Time / Part-Time)Location: FrankfurtEmployment scope: Full-Time / Part-Time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, initially limited to 2 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E11- E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.The position is within the Geobiodiversity Information and Data Management team of the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Centre and contributes to a project funded by the European Union, TETTRIX – TETTRIs neXt level for the taxonomy of tomorrow. The team works at the interface of biodiversity informatics, ecological modelling, and data management, focusing on integrating, analysing, and making biodiversity data accessible for research and conservation. The TETTRIX project aims to strengthen taxonomic capacity for biodiversity research by developing, validating, and scaling innovative tools, workflows, services, and training pathways, while addressing critical knowledge and capacity gaps across Europe. Within the TETTRIX project, the position will develop a web-based, open-access biodiversity mapping and Species Distribution Modelling (SDM) platform that enables reproducible data and modelling workflows and transforms biodiversity data into actionable knowledge for biodiversity monitoring and conservation. The role combines full-stack software development with biodiversity data integration and close collaboration with researchers and technical partners.Your tasks- Develop the platform's web application end-to-end: SPA frontend (interactive map, species/variable selection, model-run monitoring) and REST API backend.- Integrate the application with the PostgreSQL/PostGIS metadata layer and the AWS-side batch and data-lake services.- Co-design and implement the data infrastructure of the Open Modular SDM Platform, including a columnar lakehouse (Parquet, DuckDB, Dask on AWS Batch) covering the full GBIF and OBIS datasets.- Develop and operate the hybrid infrastructure, integrating AWS-based services with the institute's internal serving layer (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, map tiles and APIs), and coordinate the associated technical tasks.- Implement map-tile serving, caching and optimise frontend performance.- Set up and maintain CI/CD, automated tests and containerised deployment (Docker) in cooperation with central IT.- Participate in project and team meetings and coordinate closely with the scientific team on a day-to-day basis.Your profile- Degree in Computer Science or comparable practical experience.- Solid skills in TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern framework (React, Vue or similar).- Backend experience in Python (e.g. FastAPI/Flask) or Node.js; sound REST API design.- Experience with SQL/PostgreSQL; PostGIS and web-mapping libraries (MapLibre GL, Leaflet, OpenLayers) are a strong plus.- Experience with cloud-based data infrastructure, particularly AWS services (S3, Batch).- Knowledge of columnar data storage and lakehouse technologies (Parquet, DuckDB, Dask).- Experience with data pipelines, batch processing and the integration of large-scale datasets.- Knowledge of hybrid infrastructure architectures and the integration of cloud-based and on-premises services.- Experience with Docker, Git and CI/CD.- Very good command of English.- Willingness to work on site in Frankfurt (up to 40% remote work is possible).Desirable skills- Familiarity with open-access biodiversity databases such as the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) and the Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS), Darwin Core standards, and biodiversity data life cycles- Familiarity with species distribution modelling and associated statistical/machine-learning approaches (e.g. GLM/GAM, MaxEnt, Random Forest)- A track record in scientific publications, reproducible scientific computing, or open-source projectsWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application (letter of motivation, CV, relevantcertificates and references, if available) electronically as a single PDF by 15. November2026.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Dr. Hanieh Saeediat hanieh.saeedi@senckenberg.de

jobs.description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at its institute Senckenberg am Meer, German Centre for Marine Biodiversity Research in Hamburg, starting as soon as possibleResearch Scientist and Project Coordinator (m/f/d) in the field of Zooplankton Biodiversity(full time / part-time )Location: HamburgEmployment scope: full-time / part-time options availableType of contract: temporary contract limited until 30.09.2029Remuneration: collective agreement of the state Hesse, TV-H E13﻿The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.As part of the institute “Senckenberg am Meer” located in Wilhelmshaven, with its two departments Marine Research and German Centre for Marine Biodiversity Research (DZMB), the Hamburg research site, which belongs to the DZMB, focuses on researching taxonomy and systematics of marine life forms.The position is based within the Zooplankton Working Group and is part of the joint project ZooM-In (Innovative Methods for National Zooplankton Monitoring), contributing to the further development and standardization of modern methods for marine biodiversity monitoring. The project is funded by the Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Action, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN) through the National Biodiversity Monitoring Centre’s initiative Sustainable Biodiversity Monitoring.The project will be carried out in close cooperation with the Helmholtz Institute for Functional Marine Biodiversity (HIFMB) as well as federal and state authorities.Your tasks- Project management of the project ZooM-In- Organisation of and participation in monthly expeditions (March-October, 3-4 days per months) to the North Sea- Organisation of project workshops- Assessment of zooplankton biodiversity by imaging technologies- Cross validation of zooplankton biodiversity assessment by traditional microscopy, molecular genetics and imaging methods- Communication of project results to stakeholders- Publication of project results in peer-reviewed journals- Writing of a project reportYour profile- Master degree in marine biology or natural sciences- Expertise in the application of plankton imaging technologies (ZooScan and/or PlanktoScope)- Relevant knowledge on molecular genetic analyses of organisms, ideally metabarcoding of zooplankton- Experience in data analyses, preferably using R- Experience with sea-going expeditions on research vessels and sampling of plankton, resilience to motion sickness- Willingness to participate in interdisciplinary work- Very good communication skills, ability to work in a highly collaborative, interdisciplinary and international environment- Very good command of English (written and spoken)- Sound command of the German language is essential for this positionWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan- Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV, certificates of academic achievements, list of publications as well as letter(s) of recommendation, if available) (as a single PDF, max. 10 MB) on our career pagehttps://www.senckenberg.de/de/karriere/ by 8 November 2026.For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/.For further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung please visit www.senckenberg.de.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt a.M.If you have any specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Jasmin Renz at jasmin.renz@senckenberg.de.

jobs.occupation: Marketing Specialist (m/f/d) - Promotion & Events with a passion for aviation (Werbeleiter/in)
jobs.description: As Marketing Specialist (m/f/d), you will be a central interface between brand strategy, communications, promotion, events and business development. You will shape the external perception of AutoGyro, strengthen the positioning of our brand and products, and create exceptional experiences for customers, partners and other relevant stakeholders.Your focus lies on strategic marketing communications, PR, brand development, promotion and events. You combine strategic thinking with a strong sense of aesthetics, premium positioning and commercial awareness.Join our dynamic team and play an active part in our company’s success. You can look forward to attractive terms and conditions, as well as a free lunch every day.Tasks- Drive the implementation of the strategic vision and objectives defined by the Head of Sales & Marketing- Development and implementation of marketing and communications activities in line with the overall business strategy- Strengthening and further development of the AutoGyro brand and its positioning in relevant markets- Development and implementation of PR, media relations and brand storytelling activities- Planning and execution of promotional campaigns and initiatives to increase brand awareness and market presence- Conceptualization and execution of premium events, trade shows, customer experiences and other promotional activities- Development of compelling brand experiences and experiential marketing concepts such as “The Art of Flying”- Identification and development of relevant partnerships, cooperation opportunities and business development initiatives- Management of awards submissions and other opportunities to increase brand visibility- Development of merchandising concepts and a consistent, premium-oriented brand environment- Acting as a brand ambassador and spokesperson in selected channels and at relevant events- Supporting the Head of Sales at official events, customer meetings, international appointments and other external activities- Close collaboration with Sales and other internal stakeholders on brand, communication and business development topics- Monitoring relevant market, luxury, lifestyle and aviation trends and translating insights into marketing and business opportunities- Supporting the development of communication materials, campaigns and content across relevant channelsRequirements- Degree in Marketing, Communications, PR, Media, Business or a comparable qualification- Professional experience in marketing, communications, PR, events or a comparable field- Strong expertise in Brand Communication, PR, Storytelling and promotional activities- Experience in event management and the creation of engaging customer experiences- Strong understanding of brand development and commercial positioning- Excellent communication and presentation skills in both German and English- Confident and professional appearance when representing the company externally- Creative mindset combined with strong organizational and project management skills- Structured, independent and hands-on working style with a high sense of quality- Willingness to travel for customer events, trade shows and official appointments- Experience in luxury, premium brands, aviation, lifestyle or high-end technical products is a strong plus- Experience in business development, strategic partnerships or merchandising is a plus- Passion for aviation!Application TaskTo ensure a fair and comparable assessment of all applicants, the following task is part of the application process:- Social Media Post: Create a fictional social media post for a platform of your choice promoting AutoGyro’s participation as an exhibitor at a major international trade fair. The objective is to attract attention, generate interest and encourage visitors to visit the AutoGyro booth.- Video Reel: Create a short video reel, e.g. for Instagram, that conveys the beauty and fascination of flying in an emotional way and presents the AutoGyro brand in a visually appealing manner.Please note: Applications submitted without completing the required task cannot be considered, as the task is an integral part of the selection process and allows us to assess all applicants on a comparable basis.Benefits- Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.- Supportive and international team culture.- Flexible working hours (flexitime) to support work–life balance.- Corporate fitness programme (Hansefit).- Employer contributions to the pension scheme.- Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.- Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.- Free daily lunch at our headquarter.- Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.- Unique aviation experience – including a gyrocopter sightseeing flight.Are you ready for an exciting career in aviation? Then join AutoGyro GmbH.We are the world market leader in the development, production and sale of gyrocopters and work with partners in more than 40 countries. Our headquarters and production facility are located at Hildesheim Airport. With state-of-the-art technologies, a high degree of vertical integration and a clear vision for sustainable aviation, we are actively shaping the future.Since our foundation in 1999, we have grown steadily and now employ an international team of nearly 100 qualified specialists and engineers. Through our global sales network, we are consistently pursuing our goal: to bring the thrill of flying, maximum safety and the versatile applications of the Gyro to people all over the world.
